### GT save function 

```{r portal-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)

standings <- readr::read_csv("standings.csv")

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

```

```{r acc-base-standings, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
standings |> 
  dplyr::select(
    team, overall_rec, Win_Pct, GB, total_rs, total_ra, run_diff, home_rec, away_rec

  dplyr::mutate(run_diff = as.numeric(run_diff)) |>

  cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(team, team) |>

    team = "",
    overall_rec = "W-L",
    Win_Pct = "PCT",
    GB = "GB",
    run_diff_display = "+/-",
    home_rec = "Home",
    away_rec = "Away"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_hide(c(total_rs, total_ra, run_diff)) |>
  gt::cols_move(columns = run_diff_display, after = GB) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(baseball_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note = gt::html("<hr><Non-conference games between conference opponents</br>Wake Forest beat Clemson 15-4 in seven innings on April 1<br>North Carolina beat Duke 13-0 in seven innings on May 3<br><hr><b>Table by Chris at Bless your chart | data via ncaa.org through May 3 games</b>")) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(team)) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(run_diff_display)) |>
  gtExtras::gt_add_divider(columns = c(team, Win_Pct), 
                           sides = "right", color = "black") |> 
  gtUtils::gt_border_bars_bottom(c("#636363", "#969696", "#cccccc")) |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(Win_Pct),
    direction = "column",
    method = "numeric",
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
    domain = c(.25, .85),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) |>
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = run_diff_display),
    fn = function(x) {
      parts <- strsplit(x, "\\|\\|")
      purrr::map_chr(parts, function(p) {
        val <- as.numeric(p[1])
        sub_label <- p[2]
        txt_color <- ifelse(val > 0, "#2e7d32", ifelse(val < 0, "#c62828", "black"))
        prefix <- ifelse(val > 0, "+", "")
        glue::glue(
          '<div style="text-align:center;">
             <span style="font-weight:700;color:{txt_color};">{prefix}{val}</span><br>
             <span style="font-size:0.72em;color:#888;">{sub_label}</span>
           </div>'
        )
      })
    }
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)  
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(),
      gt::cells_column_labels(),
      gt::cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(575)) -> acc_base_tbl
```

### Run differentials plot 

```{r run-diffs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


url <- "https://www.warrennolan.com/baseball/2026/schedule/north-carolina"
page <- rvest::read_html(url)

game_blocks <- page |>
  rvest::html_elements("li.team-schedule")

parse_game <- function(block, game_id) {
  month <- block |>
    rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__game-date--month") |>
    rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  day <- block |>
    rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__game-date--day") |>
    rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  date_str <- paste0(month, " ", day, " 2026")
  date <- as.Date(date_str, format = "%b %d %Y")
  
  loc_text <- block |>
    rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__location") |>
    rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  game_location <- dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(loc_text, "AT") ~ "Away",
    stringr::str_detect(loc_text, "VS") ~ "Neutral",
    TRUE ~ "Home"
  )
  
  opponent <- block |>
    rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__opp-line-link") |>
    rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  
  rpi_text <- block |>
    rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__opp-rank") |>
    rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  rpi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(rpi_text, "\\d+")))
  
  result_text <- block |>
    rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__result") |>
    rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  
  box_table <- block |>
    rvest::html_element("table.team-schedule-bottom__box-score")
  if (is.na(box_table)) return(NULL)
  
  box_rows <- box_table |> rvest::html_elements("tr")
  if (length(box_rows) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  parse_row <- function(row) {
    team <- row |>
      rvest::html_elements("td") |>
      rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) |>
      dplyr::first()
    
    inning_vals <- row |>
      rvest::html_elements(
        "td.team-schedule-bottom__box-score:not(.team-schedule-bottom__box-score--totals)"
      ) |>
      rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
    inning_vals <- inning_vals[-1]
    
    totals <- row |>
      rvest::html_elements("td.team-schedule-bottom__box-score--totals") |>
      rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    list(team = team, innings = inning_vals, totals = totals)
  }
  
  row2 <- parse_row(box_rows[[2]])
  row3 <- parse_row(box_rows[[3]])
  
  if (is.null(row2) || is.null(row3)) return(NULL)
  
  is_unc <- function(name) {
    stringr::str_detect(name, "North Carolina") &
      !stringr::str_detect(name, "State|A&T|Greensboro|Wilmington|Charlotte")
  }
  
  if (!is_unc(row2$team) && !is_unc(row3$team)) return(NULL)
  
  unc_row <- if (is_unc(row2$team)) row2 else row3
  opp_row <- if (is_unc(row2$team)) row3 else row2
  
  n_innings <- max(length(unc_row$innings), length(opp_row$innings))
  if (n_innings == 0) return(NULL)
  
  innings_df <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_innings), function(i) {
    unc_val <- if (i <= length(unc_row$innings)) unc_row$innings[i] else NA_character_
    opp_val <- if (i <= length(opp_row$innings)) opp_row$innings[i] else NA_character_
    
    clean <- function(v) {
      if (is.na(v) || v == "X" || v == "") NA_real_ else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    }
    
    unc_runs <- clean(unc_val)
    opp_runs <- clean(opp_val)
    both_na <- is.na(unc_runs) & is.na(opp_runs)
    unc_for_diff <- dplyr::if_else(is.na(unc_runs), 0, unc_runs)
    opp_for_diff <- dplyr::if_else(is.na(opp_runs), 0, opp_runs)
    
    tibble::tibble(
      inning = i,
      unc_runs = unc_runs,
      opp_runs = opp_runs,
      inning_diff = dplyr::if_else(!both_na, unc_for_diff - opp_for_diff, NA_real_),
      score_inn = dplyr::if_else(
        !both_na,
        paste0(dplyr::if_else(is.na(unc_runs), "x", as.character(unc_runs)), "-",
               dplyr::if_else(is.na(opp_runs), "x", as.character(opp_runs))),
        NA_character_
      )
    )
  })
  
  unc_total <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unc_row$totals[1]))
  opp_total <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(opp_row$totals[1]))
  
  innings_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      game_id = game_id,
      date = date,
      game_location = game_location,
      opponent = opponent,
      rpi = rpi,
      unc_total = unc_total,
      opp_total = opp_total,
      diff_total = unc_total - opp_total,
      score_total = paste0(unc_total, "-", opp_total),
      result_text = result_text
    )
}

innings_by_game_scraped <- purrr::imap(
  as.list(game_blocks),
  \(block, idx) purrr::possibly(parse_game, NULL)(block, idx)
) |>
  purrr::compact() |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

innings_by_game_scraped <- innings_by_game_scraped |>
  dplyr::group_by(opponent) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    multi_game = dplyr::n_distinct(game_id) > 1,
    game_num = dplyr::dense_rank(game_id)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(opponent_label = opponent)

rpi_lookup <- innings_by_game_scraped |>
  dplyr::distinct(game_id, rpi)


innings_wide <- innings_by_game_scraped |>
  dplyr::select(game_id, date, game_location, opponent_label, inning, 
                inning_diff, unc_runs, opp_runs, score_inn) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = inning,
    values_from = c(inning_diff, unc_runs, opp_runs, score_inn),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(starts_with("score_inn_"), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, "")))

max_innings <- innings_by_game_scraped |>
  dplyr::summarise(max_inn = max(inning)) |>
  dplyr::pull(max_inn)


innings_wide <- innings_wide |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    unc_total = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::matches("^unc_runs_\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    opp_total = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::matches("^opp_runs_\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_total = unc_total - opp_total,
    score_total = paste0(unc_total, "-", opp_total)
  )

innings_wide_filtered <- innings_wide |>
  dplyr::left_join(rpi_lookup, by = "game_id") |>
  dplyr::filter((unc_total + opp_total) > 0) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(rpi) | rpi < 101) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(date), dplyr::desc(game_id)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(grp = "INDIVIDUAL GAMES") 


totals_row <- innings_wide_filtered |>
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    opponent_label = "North Carolina",
    date = as.Date(NA),
    game_location = "",
    grp = "SEASON TOTALS",
    diff_total = unc_total - opp_total,
    score_total = paste0(unc_total, "-", opp_total)
  )


for (i in seq_len(max_innings)) {
  unc_col <- paste0("unc_runs_", i); opp_col <- paste0("opp_runs_", i); diff_col <- paste0("inning_diff_", i)
  if (unc_col %in% names(totals_row)) totals_row[[diff_col]] <- totals_row[[unc_col]] - totals_row[[opp_col]]
}

for (i in seq_len(max_innings)) {
  unc_col <- paste0("unc_runs_", i); opp_col <- paste0("opp_runs_", i); score_col <- paste0("score_inn_", i)
  if (unc_col %in% names(totals_row)) totals_row[[score_col]] <- paste0(totals_row[[unc_col]], "-", totals_row[[opp_col]])
}

innings_wide_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(totals_row, innings_wide_filtered) |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_order = dplyr::row_number())


diff_cols <- paste0("inning_diff_", seq_len(max_innings))
score_cols <- paste0("score_inn_", seq_len(max_innings))
diff_cols <- diff_cols[diff_cols %in% names(innings_wide_final)]
score_cols <- score_cols[score_cols %in% names(innings_wide_final)]

baseball_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
     <div><img src='https://a3.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=%2Fredesign%2Fassets%2Fimg%2Ficons%2FESPN%2Dicon%2Dbaseball.png' style='height: 40px;'></div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; text-align: center;'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; font-size: 24px;'>Carolina run differentials against RPI Top 100 Opponents</span>
       <span style='font-size: 14px;'>UNC is 21-8-1 against Top 100 RPI opponents through May 3 games</span>
     </div>
     <div><img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/153.png' style='height: 40px;'></div>
   </div><br>"
)

innings_tbl <- innings_wide_final |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    game_desc = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(date) ~ "",
      TRUE ~ paste0(game_location, " | ", format(as.Date(date), "%b. %d, %Y"))
    ),
    opponent_logo = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_remove(opponent_label, "\\s*\\(\\d+\\)"))
  ) |>
  cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(opponent_label, opponent_label) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    opponent_logo = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(opponent_label, "North Carolina") ~ "Overall: 21-8-1",
      TRUE ~ opponent_label
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(opponent_label_display = opponent_logo) |>
  dplyr::relocate(opponent_label_display) |> 
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "grp") |> # use row groups 
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
  gt::tab_options(
    row_group.as_column = FALSE,
    row_group.background.color = "#f9f9f9",
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.padding = gt::px(8)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(opponent_label_display, align = "left") |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns  = dplyr::all_of(c(diff_cols, "diff_total")),
    colors   = scales::col_bin(
      bins    = c(-Inf, -0.5, 0.5, Inf),
      palette = c("#ffe7e7", "#eeeeee", "#d0e4f3")
    ),
    na_color = "#fdfdfd"
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = opponent_label_display, col2 = game_desc,
    palette = c("black", "#333333"), small_cap = FALSE
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = diff_total, col2 = score_total,
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  )

for (i in seq_along(diff_cols)) {
  d_col <- diff_cols[i]; s_col <- score_cols[i]
  if (s_col %in% names(innings_wide_final)) {
    innings_tbl <- innings_tbl |>
      gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(col1 = !!rlang::sym(d_col), col2 = !!rlang::sym(s_col), palette = c("black", "#333333"))
  }
}

innings_tbl <- innings_tbl |>
  gt::cols_add(total_gap = "", .before = diff_total) |>
  gt::cols_label(opponent_label_display = "", diff_total = "TOTAL", total_gap = "") |>
  gt::cols_label(.list = setNames(as.list(as.character(seq_along(diff_cols))), diff_cols)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "Innings", columns = dplyr::all_of(diff_cols)) |>
  gt::fmt(
    columns = dplyr::all_of(diff_cols),
    fns = function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", ifelse(x > 0, paste0("+", x), as.character(x)))
  ) |>
  gt::fmt(columns = diff_total, fns = function(x) ifelse(x > 0, paste0("+", x), as.character(x))) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(sides = "all", color = "black", weight = gt::px(2))),
    locations = list(gt::cells_body(), gt::cells_column_labels(), gt::cells_column_spanners())
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(baseball_header)) |>
  gtUtils::gt_538_caption(
    "Data via warrennolan.com, theme via {gtUtils}, logos from ESPN.",
    "<b>Table by Chris at Bless your chart through May 3 games</b>"
  ) |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_bars_bottom(c("#56a0d3", "#89BDE0", "#BBD9ED")) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(900)) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = opponent_label_display) |> 
  gt::cols_hide(c(
    dplyr::all_of(score_cols), dplyr::matches("^unc_runs_\\d+$"),
    dplyr::matches("^opp_runs_\\d+$"), unc_total, opp_total,
    date, game_location, game_id, opponent_label, rpi, row_order
  ))


gt_save_crop(
  innings_tbl,
  file = "unc_inning_diff.png",
  whitespace = 60,
  bg = "white"
)

innings_tbl
```
